# Facial Surgery Center

> Facial Surgery Center has provided oral and maxillofacial surgery from its Trumbull, Connecticut office for more than 30 years. The practice serves patients across Fairfield and New Haven counties and coordinates care with referring dentists and orthodontists.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/): Practice overview and appointment information.
- [Meet the doctors](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/about/meet-the-doctors): Surgeon credentials and background.
- [Areas we serve](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/areas-we-serve): Service-area hub.
- [Patient information](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/for-patients/what-to-expect): What to expect before and after treatment.
- [Contact](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/contact): Office contact and appointment details.

## Services

- [Dental implants](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/dental-implants)
- [Tooth extractions](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/tooth-extractions)
- [Wisdom teeth removal](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/wisdom-teeth-removal)
- [Corrective jaw surgery](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/orthognathic-surgery)
- [Facial trauma](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/facial-trauma)
- [Anesthesia](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/anesthesia)
- [Bone grafting](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/dental-bone-grafting)
- [TMJ disorders](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/tmj-disorder)
- [Sleep apnea surgery](https://www.facialsurgeryct.com/service/sleep-apnea)

## Service areas

Facial Surgery Center serves patients from Trumbull and the following Connecticut communities. Each listed location has a dedicated page with local appointment and care information.
